notes: The KiCad ending (storyboard 4b, decisions 0028 and 0030): a desktop recording of the schematic editor the app opened, appended where the take clicked Open in KiCad.

zoom.cx/cy: the title block's centre as a fraction of the captured area, measured on a maximized KiCad 9 window at 1920x1020 (HL-HW-26-0049, 2026-11-22; cy raised 2026-11-24 so the crop ends above the status bar). Re-check the frames if KiCad's layout changes.
